items.html: Now, the aspect of the male of Arich Anpin has been explained. We shall therefore now explain the aspect of the female, for she is the one made from the selections of the Kings of BON. It is necessary to explain the reality of this selection, and with it the whole of Arich Anpin in its entirety — male and female — will also be explained, for all of Atzilut was not selected and corrected except through Iburim [impregnations]. Every Partzuf was corrected and selected through the Partzuf above it and higher than it, which, by coupling with the female, would select the parts needed for this lower one, and they were there in the female in the aspect of a twelve-month Ibur, and it was corrected.
